how_to_apply: The notice asks for a paper application, not an online one. The steps below follow the notice.
Download the application form from the "Recruitment" section of the Krishnagiri District website (https://krishnagiri.nic.in/) or from the NHM website (https://nhm.tn.gov.in).
Attach photocopies of all the certificates listed below. Applications without them will be rejected.
Submit the application in person or via Speed Post.
Address it to: The Secretary / District Health Officer, District Collectorate Back Side, Near Regional Transport Office (RTO), Ramapuram Post, Krishnagiri District - 635 115.
Make sure it reaches the Krishnagiri District Health Office on or before 04.12.2026 at 5:00 PM.
Proof of Date of Birth: Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC Certificate.
Educational Qualification and Mark Sheet: SSLC, HSC, DGNM / B.Sc., Nursing Certificate.
Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate, and also the renewal certificate if eligible.
Proof of Tamil Eligibility: 10th or 12th Standard Mark sheet.
Proof of Residence: any one of Voter ID, Aadhaar Card or Ration Card.
Character and Conduct Certificate issued by a Group A or Group B Government Officer, dated within the last 3 months.
Any other certificate relevant to the applicable scoring criteria, wherever applicable.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely temporary on contract basis under NHM and confers no right to claim regularization. Selected candidates will be placed as per G.O.(Ms).No 427 Health and Family welfare EAP-II/1 Department, dated 18.11.2026. The number of vacancies is subject to change. Applications submitted without photocopies of the listed certificates will be rejected. Complete details are on the official website of Krishnagiri District (https://krishnagiri.nic.in/).

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in Krishnagiri under NHM?
faq.answer: There are 73 vacancies: 61 in Government Hospitals (DMS) and 12 in Government Medical Colleges (DME). The number is subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Krishnagiri District Health Office on or before 04.12.2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: GNM / B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government Private approved Private Nursing College, recognized by the University approved under State Norms, with valid Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurse and Midwives Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is Upto 50 Years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs.21,000/- Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I submit the application?
faq.answer: Applications are invited in person or via Speed Post, addressed to The Secretary / District Health Officer, District Collectorate Back Side, Near Regional Transport Office (RTO), Ramapuram Post, Krishnagiri District - 635 115.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The form can be downloaded from the "Recruitment" section of the Krishnagiri District website (https://krishnagiri.nic.in/) and from the NHM website (https://nhm.tn.gov.in).

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary on contract basis under NHM and does not confer any right to claim regularization.

faq.question: Q9. What happens if photocopies of certificates are not attached?
faq.answer: Applications submitted without attaching photocopies of the listed certificates will be rejected.
